answer: In an agent market trading grove surveys, jade appraisals and marble inspections, voting power is proportional to tokens locked in escrow, with a 30-day withdrawal delay. Creating a thousand identities and splitting a deposit among them gives an attacker exactly the same total voting power as one identity. To outvote honest agents, the attacker must lock more tokens than they collectively hold in escrow, tying up capital that cannot be spent or withdrawn during the delay.
